prompt: The man in the reference image remains seated and quietly listens to the unseen person to camera-right. During this three-second shot he blinks once naturally and breathes gently, keeping his mouth closed. Locked camera, one continuous shot, no cuts. Preserve the face, hair, stubble, jacket, table and lighting from the reference image. Nobody else enters the frame; no hands near his face. No speech or music; subtle quiet room ambience only if audio is generated.

modelSpec.description: Enhanced native audio, improved element consistency, and support for multi-shot storytelling. To use features related to subject/element, refer to tools such as element_create. If no element‑related tools appear in tool/lists, reconnect to the MCP server to refresh most updated tools by instruct the user to restart the current host and start a new session.

arguments.name: prompt
arguments.description: Text prompt describing the desired motion / scene. The input image is the primary driver. Required; empty string is allowed for pure image animation. To reference a reusable subject (Element), write <<<id>>> in the prompt and list that id in the 'elements' argument (an id may be referenced multiple times).

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: Video duration in seconds, support 3s to 15s. Longer durations may require prefer_multi_shots.

arguments.name: prefer_multi_shots
arguments.description: Whether to enable smart multi-shot splitting (intelligent shot composition).

arguments.name: enable_audio
arguments.description: Whether to enable audio-video sync. When 'true', the model directly produces a work that includes audio.

arguments.name: elements
arguments.description: Optional reusable subjects (Elements). JSON array string of {id, bindName}, e.g. [{"id":"12345","bindName":"Alice"}]. 'id' from element_create/element_list. Write <<<id>>> in the prompt where each subject should appear (an id may be referenced multiple times).

inputs.name: first_image
inputs.description: Source image URL used as the first frame to animate. (Must be url returned by file_upload tool, or a publicly accessible external file URL. No local file path.)

inputs.name: tail_image
inputs.description: Optional tail (last-frame) image URL; when provided, the generated video transitions toward this frame. (Must be url returned by file_upload tool, or a publicly accessible external file URL. No local file path.)

items.msg: slot first_image: URL externa (não verifiquei o conteúdo; URLs podem expirar; prazo não verificado).
